original_sql:
SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name
FROM employees e
WHERE e.emp_no NOT IN (SELECT dm.emp_no FROM dept_manager dm)
  AND e.hire_date >= '1999-06-01'

candidates.sql: SELECT e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN dept_manager dm ON e.emp_no = dm.emp_no WHERE dm.emp_no IS NULL AND e.hire_date >= '1999-06-01'
